boundary_evidence: One contiguous run of the Nitro SDK's gx_load3d.c, 0x020568cc..0x02056c1c: 6 functions. pret/pokediamond's arm9/lib/NitroSDK/src/GX_load3d.c, compiled with its own pinned mwccarm 1.2/sp2p3, emits 10: the four clear-image loaders, then GX_EndLoadTexPltt 0x58, GX_LoadTexPltt 0x74, GX_BeginLoadTexPltt 0x48, GX_EndLoadTex 0x70, GX_LoadTex 0x164, GX_BeginLoadTex 0x80. The last six land here in that order, five at pret's sizes and LoadTex at 0x14c (SDK version drift). The clear-image loaders are absent because nothing in this game calls them.
BOTTOM EDGE: GX_LoadBGPltt at 0x02056870 is gx_load2d.c's last function (arm9/GXS); the edge is the file edge 0x020568cc.
TOP EDGE: Copy48BytesFixed (0x02056c1c) is a hand-assembled MI block-copy primitive.
These are NitroSDK C functions under their SDK names (extern "C"), not a class: no this, no vtable, no layout.
